ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12; high-intensity white pixels are sparse relative to the dominant low-intensity black/dark-grey pigment across the ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black field across the entire ventral surface, punctuated by high-contrast white circular and oval clusters (mottling) ranging from 2-15 pixels in diameter, distributed across the mid-section and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth representing roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a concave arc sweeping upward from the median notch toward the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible spatial distribution of approximately 30-40 small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (potential rosette scars) concentrated primarily in the lower-central region of the left lobe and scattered across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, high-contrast vertical/diagonal linear markings: one prominent white line approximately 40 pixels in length on the medial section of the left lobe, and a shorter marking near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two large, high-relief, textured tan/beige pixel clusters (external biological attachments/barnacles) located exactly at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
